summary_1line: Ravana invades Yama’s realm, witnesses hell’s punishments and rewards, frees the damned, and battles Yama’s armies with devastating celestial weapons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana’s radiant Pushpaka chariot blazes like the sun as it descends into the dark realm of Yama, illuminating the land of the dead.
The Vaitarani river of blood where tormented souls struggle through burning sand while worms and dogs devour the damned on the banks.
Ravana stands blood-soaked on the battlefield, drawing the flaming Pashupata missile as Yama’s vast army surrounds him like storm clouds.
